title: Fr\'echetFlow: Flow Matching for Non-Euclidean Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.15220v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific observations such as probability distributions, trees and covariance matrices call for generative models that respect their non-Euclidean geometry. While flow matching has been extended to manifolds by utilizing geodesics and velocities, such manifold structures are not available in a general metric space. We introduce Fr\'echetFlow, a generative modeling framework for metric space-valued data that requires neither linear operations nor a smooth manifold structure. A key feature of the proposed approach is that we utilize well-established Euclidean flows to learn the joint distribution of distances to a set of landmarks, whereupon new objects are reconstructed from generated landmark representations. The reconstruction step utilizes weighted Fr\'echet means of reference objects, drawing on Fr\'echet regression. We establish Wasserstein error bounds that connect accuracy of the generated object distributions to the placement

translated_title: FréchetFlow：面向非欧几里得数据的流匹配
translated_abstract: 概率分布、树结构和协方差矩阵等科学观测数据需要能够尊重其非欧几里得几何特性的生成模型。虽然流匹配已通过利用测地线和速度场被扩展到流形上，但在一般度量空间中并不存在这样的流形结构。我们提出了FréchetFlow，一个面向度量空间取值数据的生成建模框架，它既不需要线性运算，也不需要光滑流形结构。该方法的一个关键特征是，我们利用成熟的欧几里得流来学习对象到一组基准点距离的联合分布，然后从生成的基准点表示中重构新对象。重构步骤借鉴Fréchet回归，利用参考对象的加权Fréchet均值。我们建立了Wasserstein误差界，将生成对象分布的精度与基准点的放置方式联系起来。
tldr: 本文提出了FréchetFlow，一个无需线性运算或光滑流形结构的度量空间数据生成建模框架，通过欧几里得流学习到基准点距离的联合分布，并借助加权Fréchet均值重构生成新对象。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FréchetFlow, a generative modeling framework for metric space-valued data requiring neither linear operations nor smooth manifold structure, which learns the joint distribution of distances to landmarks via Euclidean flows and reconstructs new objects using weighted Fréchet means.
